body.what_is:
The Grésy-sur-Isère leisure base, run by Arlysère, lines up a beach, a lake, a play area, a picnic area and toilets by the Isère, in the Combe de Savoie. Access is free.

The site is a Pavillon Bleu laureate — it appears on the label's official laureate list, category Beach, and the Savoie Mont Blanc listing cites it for its sustainable-development policy.

Swimming is supervised daily 12:00–18:00 in summer. On the exact 2026 dates, the two official sources differ by a day: 27 June to 27 August per Arlysère, the operator; 26 June to 26 August per Savoie Mont Blanc. We give both. One honesty note: the IGN geocoder has no 'lake' point at Grésy-sur-Isère — so this page ships without coordinates.
